lines.t: Before the light broke through the dark of the deep
You were singing over nothing and it woke us from sleep
You are the Lord my God and my Noel, Holy One of Israel
You are my righteousness, anointed and true
The only God and Savior, I belong to You
The bright morning star, the everlasting light
The one who was and is and is to come in might
From the dust of the ground
To the breath in my lungs
Every heartbeat answers the song you have sung
You are I am
The first and the last
The kingdom that's come and the rock that will stand
You are I am
My Savior and friend, the way and the truth, life without end, you arrived, you arrived.
You are the Passover, the lamb that was slain, my ransom and my refuge, the breaker of chains.
Firstborn from the dead, risen in power, my horn of salvation, my strong tower.
You are the mediator, redeemer and priest
The keeper of your saints from the greatest to least
The song in my chest, the tears in my eyes
The nectar of life that never runs dry
From the cross and the grave to the throne
Up above every road I wander is covered in love
You are I Am, the first and the last
The kingdom that's coming, the rock that will stand
You are I, my Savior and friend, the way and the truth, life without end
You are I, You are I
You are the wisdom, the word that was spoken
The faithful and true, when the world's faith is broken
Seeker of the broken, sower of the seed, and reaper of souls, the goal of the Torah, the fulfillment of all.
You are the mercy seat and righteous fire, the judge of the nations and my heart's desire,
the cornerstone chosen, the tree and the branch, the son of David who still holds my hand from the law
And the prophets to the Lamb who were slain
Every line of scripture whispers your name
You are I Am
The first and the last
The kingdom that's coming
The rock that will stand
You are I Am
My Savior and friend
The way and the truth
Life without end
You are I Am
You are I Am
You are the shepherd, the gate for the sheep
The master who guides and the guard while we sleep
You are the helper, the spirit, the flame
The still small voice who is calling my name
You are the healer, the sanctuary
The fountain of waters that wash and carry
The lion of Judah, the warrior of light
The one with a sword made of true words of life
King of kings, Lord of lords
You open doors no one can close
Holder of the keys of death
You give your people living breath
Face of God, the invisible scene
The holy presence where we are made clean
Alpha, Omega, beginning and end
My God, my Father, my closest friend
You are I Am
The first and the last
The kingdom that's coming
The rock that will stand
You are I Am
My Savior and friend
The way and the truth
Life without end
You are, I am, the all in all, the meaning of life, the one who calls.
You are, I am, my soul's reward, forever my life, my love, my Lord.
You are Yahushua, our Messiah.
You are for us and we for you.
You are the all in all.
You are, I am.
